{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-dhuo","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-1ror: transcript_4 parameter named ciphertext_3 but receives PLAINTEXT_3","description":"## Summary

## Severity
P3 — readability/naming. No behavioral impact.
